description: Candidate example cars and their estimated value when new (v0). The page picks, for each slot, the youngest model year whose estimated value fits the user's maximum price: value(age) = v0 x the page's depreciation curve (AGE_DEP).

source.name: Verohallinto / Finnish Tax Administration: applied taxation values of passenger cars, 2025 and 2026 (January-September)

method: v0 = median over the model's tax decisions of value / depreciation(age). Model years available come from the Traficom register (catalogue field 'years', 5th-95th percentile of first registration). Mileage = age x the model's median annual mileage in the register.

rules.petrol: Always the Volkswagen Golf, Finland's most common car of median age.
rules.hybrid: Toyota Corolla if it fits the budget, else Auris, else Yaris (the most common full hybrids).
rules.electric: Of the candidates that fit the budget, the one with the most cars in the Finnish register. If none fits, the cheapest one, flagged as over budget.
